capabilities: select a global browser for external links
define custom browser profiles with launch commands
bind modifier keys and mouse buttons to specific browsers
extras: Installation is manual via zip from the releases page; only macOS and Windows profile examples are given.
intentEvidence: Choose your own way to open external links.
problem: Obsidian opens external links in the system default browser, with no way to pick a different browser per click or context.
summary: Link-opener utility that lets you choose which browser (or custom browser profile) opens external links clicked in Obsidian.
